ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

5. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

6. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

7. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

9. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.

10. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.

11. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

12. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Combinational Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Home- based Automatic Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Project Implementation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
